queries_run: Motorola Solutions market share LMR 2026 competitors Hytera Tait Sepura L3Harris
Motorola Solutions new entrant displace threat mission critical communications FirstNet broadband push-to-talk 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 稱公司面對數量增加的既有與新競爭者；MCN 主要對手含 Airbus、Hytera、JVCKenwood、L3Harris、Persistent Systems、Sepura、Tait、TrellisWare 等。
findings.excerpt: We experience widespread competition from a growing number of existing and new competitors.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：新技術與新競爭者進入市場的速度比過去快；收購 Silvus 後，在部分產品面對新創與國防承包商的競爭加劇。
findings.excerpt: new technologies and new competitors continue to enter our markets at a faster pace than in the past

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：多國政府有計畫將公安通訊從 LMR 轉到公共行動寬頻網路，目前進展有限，若客戶認為寬頻足夠，可能衝擊 MCN 銷售。
findings.excerpt: While such initiatives have gained limited traction to date, if customers conclude that public mobile broadband networks, potentially augmented with emerging technologies, provide adequate resiliency, coverage, control, and cost for their critical communication needs, it could adversely affect our MCN sales.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到可靠且有來源的 2026 份額數字或具名新進入者搶單事件；市調頁的份額數字互相矛盾，未採用。
